children: RAISES 4Q26 TTF GAS PRICE FORECAST TO 100 €/MWH IN NOTE DATED SEPT 15
SAYS IF STRONG EL NIÑO LEADS TO MILD EUROPEAN WINTER WEATHER, THEN WINTER TTF PRICES COULD DROP BELOW 50 €/MWH
SAYS COLD WINTER COULD DRIVE TTF TO THE 2022 HIGHS AS PHYSICAL CONSUMERS AND GOVERNMENTS SCRAMBLE FOR LNG SUPPLIES
SAYS HIGHER TTF PRICES WOULD LIKELY BE NEEDED TO SPUR ADDITIONAL EUROPEAN DEMAND DESTRUCTION
EXPECTS TTF PRICES TO FALL TO ~40 €/MWH BY 2H27
SAYS THERE COULD BE FURTHER UPSIDE RISK TO 2027 PRICES IF QATAR HAS NOT RESUMED NORMAL LNG EXPORTS BY YEAR END.
